_comment: REFERENCE target for the /admin/marketplace/ai-import wizard proposal.
The wizard SCANS this repo and auto-generates a proposal; use this file as
the reference for what the edited proposal should look like before Apply.
Do NOT paste raw — reconcile against the wizard's generated JSON. Values
marked CONFIRM must be verified against the live platform (model registry,

appSpec.name: 4yi CAD
appSpec._resources_note: CONFIRM: size memory_request_mb to MEASURED peak RSS of the worst-case model (memory limit == request => OOMKill if under-sized). Keep schedulable on one node (<= ~28 GB on t3a.2xlarge). Do NOT aim at the 262144 validation ceiling.
appSpec._replicas_note: min_replicas=1 avoids scale-to-zero cold starts (large image); trade-off is always-on cost. Set to 0 to allow idle auto-pause if cost matters more than first-request latency.
appSpec._auth_note: platform_sso => only the installing org's SSO users reach the app. Never 'public'.
appSpec._secrets_note: No consumer secrets. The app reads ONLY the platform-injected gateway env; it reads no native LLM keys, so none should be classified as required secrets.

_manifest_note: Single public service (single-container MVP: FastAPI serves the SPA + /api + the sandboxed CadQuery worker in one image).

The app stores session metadata in SQLite and CAD artifacts on the filesystem. Defaults are pod-local /tmp paths for Private Beta; configure PVC/object storage before Public Beta/GA durability claims.
CONFIRM at deploy: /tmp must be a WRITABLE tmpfs/emptyDir mount because the sandbox worker writes there and the pod should run read-only rootfs + non-root (tenant-isolation).

models._model_note: CONFIRM: model id must exist in the platform registry and be TOOL-CALLING capable (the agent loop uses `tools`). NO forced vision capability — this is text-only. Do NOT register this slug in src/lib/app-platform/model-recommendations.ts (it hard-codes capability:'vision' and would reject text models); author defaultModel/allowedModels here in the proposal instead.

deploymentFit.notes: Stateful-lite Private Beta: server stores SQLite session/version metadata and filesystem artifacts under CAD_SESSION_DB_PATH/CAD_ARTIFACT_ROOT, defaulting to pod-local /tmp. Durable PVC/object storage is required before Public Beta or GA.
